attrs.evidence: An exhaustive search of a nine-element list. Present: Invariant Table (opensentience.org/invariants.html), Evidence Registry, Objective Portfolio, and the Operation Registry — which did NOT exist when it was described as existing and exists now because of the reply that described it. Absent: Contract Registry, Basis/Implication System, Lineage Graph, Substrate & Metrology Register, Reflection Charter. THE CONTRACT REGISTRY IS THE INSTRUCTIVE ONE. R5 refused exactly that collapse on GPT-5.6's own adjudication — a theorem's antecedent and a component's interface contract are not one semantic object even when they share a predicate — and what shipped instead was one assumption vocabulary with a `kind` discriminator. `kind: interface` is the slot a capability contract occupies; four records now sit in it, three added by this round. A slot is not a registry. Each entry's presence is resolved against the FILESYSTEM by check-mosaic.mjs §10, so this measurement cannot drift and goes red the day any of the five is built.

evidence_qualifiers.population: the nine artifacts named in GPT-5.6's reply to ROUND6_MOSAIC_BRIEF.md, each resolved against the filesystem at HEAD by check-mosaic.mjs §10. A complete enumeration of a nine-element list, not a sample — but typed as `measurement` rather than `exhaustion` because what is enumerated is a LIST SOMEONE WROTE, and the mapping from each name to the path that would satisfy it is authored. A different reader could map `Basis/Implication System` onto a different file and get a different count.

attrs.implementation_binding: scripts/check-mosaic.mjs §10 — every `exists` flag in mosaic/operations.json proposal_audit is checked with existsSync
attrs.note: Recorded without prejudice to the proposal. Four of nine is not an indictment — the Operation Registry existing at all is downstream of this reply, and three of the five absences are things this artifact probably should build.
attrs.prior_art: The loop's own recurring finding, turned on the loop: a claim about the artifact that the artifact does not check. R5.1 (support refs that resolved and supported nothing), R5.2 (a stored list that could under-report), R6 (an edge that could be absent for free). This is the fourth, and the first whose subject is a proposal rather than a gate.
attrs.review_focus: The measurement is of NAMES against a tree, and a reasonable reading is that GPT-5.6 meant the nine as a DESIGN rather than as an inventory. That reading is available and this record does not foreclose it — what it refuses is the inferential step actually taken, which was to argue that Embodiment Continuity should be re-read as a conservation theorem over a system that mostly is not built. The conclusion survives the correction; INV-R7 adopts it. The premise does not.
attrs.statement: Of the nine artifacts GPT-5.6 describes the invariant redesign as consisting of, five do not exist in this tree, and one of the five — the Contract Registry — is a proposal GPT-5.6 itself refused at INV-R5.
